leadText:
Kendrick (Japanese: ケンオー Kenō) is a minor recurring character in .

He first appeared in Curtain Up, Unova League!, where he participated in the Vertress Conference and was 's first opponent. He was shown to be a determined who focused on the match, as he told Cameron to save his chatter for later. Kendrick continued to use on Cameron's and initially had the upper hand. However, in Mission: Defeat Your Rival!, he was soon defeated and eliminated from the tournament.
